stated that Germany had rapidly become independent of Russian gas, oil, and coal; gas storage was nearly 70% full against a February target of 40%; and the government had used energy price brakes, an ]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz argued for a multipolar international order based on the UN Charter and international law, greater engagement with the Global South, expanded representation for African states in the UN Security Council and G20, and partnerships for infrastructure, food security, climate-risk protection, and equitable energy transitions.","notes":["The excerpt supports the programmatic claims but does not state the 12 May 2023 date." ]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz announced a review of all German development cooperation with the Palestinian territories, stated that no new development-cooperation funding would be made available until the review was complete, and said humanitarian assistance provided basic food and health care to more than half the population, mainly in the Gaza Strip.","notes":["The excerpt describes the existing humanitarian assistance but does not state that it would continue." ]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Scholz said protection of Jewish and Israeli institutions had been stepped up, that federal and Länder law-enforcement agencies would bring offenders to justice, that association and activity bans were available, that the Federal Interior Ministry would ban Hamas activities in Germany, and that Samidoun would be outlawed.","notes":["The excerpt states future or announced actions; it does not support presenting the Hamas or Samidoun measures as already completed.","The excerpt does not say that Scholz directly ordered law-enforcement authorities to prosecute offenses." ]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0029-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
